items.headline: Producer prices jump 1.3% in September, more than double forecasts
items.summary: The core PPI posted its biggest gain in four years. Stocks opened lower before recovering; yields fell late in the day. Adds to the case for further Fed tightening.

items.headline: Hot September CPI revives Fed rate-hike fears; Nasdaq drops 1.9%
items.summary: Headline and core inflation beat estimates. Rate-sensitive tech and financials fell hardest while energy led. Markets now price meaningful odds of a December hike.

items.headline: Oil climbs 2.2% to near $98 as Middle East tensions build
items.summary: Reports say President Trump is weighing joining Saudi Arabia against Tehran-backed Houthis in Yemen. Higher crude supports energy producers but squeezes consumers and feeds inflation.

items.headline: TSMC posts sixth straight record profit, guides Q4 to $52.3–54.3B
items.summary: Revenue of $46.7B beat the top of guidance, but 66.4% gross margin slipped on the 2nm ramp. Shares closed down about 3.4% as investors focused on margin dilution and capex.

items.headline: Nvidia falls as bond yields and debt-funded AI spending weigh
items.summary: NVDA closed at $217.23, down 1.8%, extending the prior day's 3.2% drop. Investors are questioning AI infrastructure financing with the 10-year above 5%.

items.headline: China's CXMT chip progress hits Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix
items.summary: Memory makers sold off on fears of rising competition from China's CXMT, which reported progress on a new chip structure.

items.headline: Goldman beats by ~30% on record equities trading; JPMorgan misses
items.summary: GS earned $17.01 a share on $18.68B revenue. JPMorgan's $5.57 EPS missed $5.90 despite 13% NII growth. Bank of America took a $1.2B regulatory charge.

items.headline: Apple closes above $5 trillion market value for the first time
items.summary: Apple has held up better than chip names during the AI selloff, acting as a relative safe haven within mega-cap tech.

items.headline: Dow jumps 1.1% as money rotates from AI into value
items.summary: More than half of S&P 500 stocks now trade above their 200-day averages, up from about 40% in late September. Leadership is broadening beyond mega-cap tech.

items.headline: Gold rises to ~$4,170 while bitcoin, copper and stocks slip
items.summary: Gold gained 1.6% as investors sought hedges. Bitcoin swung below $81K with $485M in liquidations before ending near $82.3K.

items.headline: European shares hit a two-week high; FTSE 100 up 1.1%
items.summary: Banks lifted London while healthcare led the STOXX 600. A disputed Russia–Ukraine 'energy ceasefire' keeps European energy prices in focus.

items.headline: Sensex slips 0.3% on wholesale inflation and high crude
items.summary: India is a large oil importer, so $98 crude pressures its inflation and currency.

items.headline: Shipping stocks hit record highs on higher oil freight rates
items.summary: Tanker and shipping names are benefiting from Middle East disruption and longer trade routes.
